episodes.title: Roger the Wanderer
episodes.synopsis: Roger Smith takes on the three foreign MegaDeuses, as well as the demons in his own mind. The battles he fights, both internal and external, will change Paradigm City forever.

episodes.title: Negotiation with the Dead
episodes.synopsis: Roger is hired by a woman to protect her husband, a retired Senator, from an assassin. Apparently, the assassin is working for the same people who controlled the ""mad bomber"" from Act:10 ""Winter Night Phantom"" and the murderous android in Act:13 ""R-D"".

episodes.title: Day of the Advent
episodes.synopsis: An unknown object crashes to Earth inside Paradigm City. While the general populace takes it as a good sign, Roger Smith isn't so sure, especially when he is hired to perform a very unusual Negotiation--one that will bring him into direct conflict with Paradigm CEO Alex Rosewater.

episodes.title: Leviathan
episodes.synopsis: Schwartzvald rears his bandaged head again, and a new MegaDeus threatens Paradigm City. Business as usual? Roger Smith sure doesn't think so.

episodes.title: The Greatest Villain
episodes.synopsis: When Beck kidnaps Roger Smith, R. Dorothy must take the case. Prepare yourself for R. Dorothy Waynewright...the Negotiator. Paradigm City will never be the same.

episodes.title: Eyewitness
episodes.synopsis: Someone is killing androids in Paradigm City. After several attacks, Paradigm HQ dispatches a special agent to assist in the case: Freddy O'Reilly. But Freddy is an android himself. He and Dastun have an uneasy working relationship. When Dorothy is targeted, she manages to avoid being destroyed and is taken in for police questioning.

episodes.title: Stripes
episodes.synopsis: Roger is still having strange flashbacks. He can only assume that they are memories, but he's not quite sure. Frustrated, he returns to visit Gordon Rosewater, the man who built Paradigm City, on his farm. Gordon only offers vague platitudes and cryptic responses, until he gives Roger one very important clue.

episodes.title: The Third Big
episodes.synopsis: Roger Smith & Dan Dastun race to R. Dorothy's aid, while Alex Rosewater finally unveils ""Big Fau"". But can he control the power of a MegaDeus once it is unleashed?

episodes.title: Hydra
episodes.synopsis: Roger is unsympathetic to Alex's problems. Alex pushes his science group to reactivate the Big Fau. Underground tremors and a power outage draw attention to these tests, and the union spy Vera unleashes a three-headed giant electric eel. Once again, Roger and the Big O find themselves facing a giant monster to protect all of Paradigm City.

episodes.title: Twisted Memories
episodes.synopsis:
Beck!!!!! I love it when that guy shows up; it makes me feel all alliterative inside. Let's see...
Beck's back, with an army of annoying android assassins [oh yeah, it's gonna be one of *those* episodes].
Alex Rosewater deals with his Daddy Issues in a very negative way [so long, Amber Waves of Grain(tm)], while at the same using Beck to kidnap R. Dorothy. And we're just gettin' warmed up...

episodes.title: The Big Fight
episodes.synopsis: Roger Smith and Big O slug it out with Alan Gabriel and ""Big Duo Inferno"" (hereafter referred to simply as ""Big Duo""), while Alex Rosewater uses R. Dorothy's Memories to complete Big Fau. And the Union is still out there...

episodes.title: The War of Paradigm City
episodes.synopsis: When high-altitude bombing levels Paradigm City, Alex Rosewater proclaims his ""New Order"". Meanwhile, Roger Smith and Angel uncover the soul-shattering secrets behind the Event, and the founding of Paradigm City.

episodes.title: The Show Must Go On
episodes.synopsis:
From the cover of ""Scientific American"", August 2003...    ""ARE YOU A HOLOGRAM? (Quantum physics says the entire universe might be)""
Now just imagine if that was really the case, and you'll have ""The Show Must Go On"" in a nutshell, which is apparently where Paradigm City has been all these years. As for the rest...
R. Dorothy rises from her deathbed, thanks (in part) to Beck. Roger Smith and Alex Rosewater stage the Showdown of the Century, while Gordon Rosewater shows Angel her true destiny.
Oh, and that little prank by Adult Swim? We are not amused.

info.title: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero's
info.synopsis: Akira Oda, uno studente delle superiori particolarmente bravo nel celare la sua presenza, viene evocato in un altro mondo assieme ai suoi compagni di classe. In questo mondo di spada e magia, viene chiesto loro di diventare degli eroi e sconfiggere il re dei demoni. Ma Akira non si fida del re e della principessa che hanno avanzato la richiesta ed utilizza la sua abilità per intrufolarsi nella biblioteca del re, alla ricerca della verità. Ora sta a lui decidere se aiutare o abbandonare i suoi compagni, che sono all'oscuro di tutto.

episodes.title: The Assassin Eats Bread
episodes.synopsis: Transported with his class to another world, Akira quickly discovers that he far surpasses his classmates.

episodes.title: The Assassin Takes Care of the Wounded
episodes.synopsis: Akira is fighting his way through the Kantinen Labyrinth when he encounters an injured elf.

episodes.title: The Assassin Plays with a Cat
episodes.synopsis: Akira Oda’s high school class is summoned to another world and granted abilities. Now, Akira is on the run!

episodes.title: The Assassin Calls the Name
episodes.synopsis: The gang encounters Kilika, Amelia's sister, who holds a massive grudge against her.

episodes.title: The Assassin Sleeps in a Bed
episodes.synopsis: Akira and gang head to the land of beastfolk and face new encounters.

episodes.title: The Assassin Fights a Demon
episodes.synopsis: Amelia has been abducted, and Akira gets some unexpected aid in his quest to take her back.

episodes.title: The Assassin Makes a Vow
episodes.synopsis: Akira faces an unprecedented challenge as Mahiro, another demon, appears to take him on.

episodes.title: The Assassin Is Spellbound
episodes.synopsis: His determination renewed, Akira now gets to... watch a beauty pageant?

episodes.title: The Assassin Sees the Sights
episodes.synopsis: Akira and the Hero's Party discuss their future course of action. Confirming that they share the same ultimate goal, they agree to go their separate ways for the time being. Thus, Akira, Amelia, and Crow head to the capital, Uruk City. There, they are reunited, and Leah escorts Akira and Amelia to the royal palace. However, during the audience, the king of Uruk blatantly disrespects Akira and even makes selfish demands. In order to appease an enraged Amelia, Akira ends up fighting the royal guard.

episodes.title: The Assassin Gazes at the River Surface
episodes.synopsis: Crow tells Akira things about Gram to convince him to kill him, but he remembers his family and hesitates.

episodes.title: The Assassin Browses
episodes.synopsis: Akira and the others investigate the Uruk City Adventurer's Guild to obtain information about Gram.

episodes.title: Oda Akira Becomes an Assassin
episodes.synopsis: After much deliberation and an unpleasant encounter with Gram at the guild, Akira decides what to do.

episodes.title: Syr
episodes.synopsis: Syr is not the only one who has feelings for Bell. When she notices the shift in her friend’s behavior, she asks Ryu a question that shakes the elf to the core.

episodes.title: Master: Training
episodes.synopsis: Hedin will not allow Bell’s date with Syr to proceed. Not until Bell can properly woo her; not until he learns... how to pick up girls in a dungeon.

episodes.title: Odr: Partner
episodes.synopsis: Bell and Syr finally go on their festival date. Unfortunately, several meddlesome groups insist on being the third wheel.

episodes.title: Seidr: God and Girl
episodes.synopsis: Bell can’t act the dense, indecisive fool—not after Syr poured her heart out to him. He must respond to her feelings honestly, but now the Freya Familia is trying to kill her.

episodes.title: Freya Familia: Invasion
episodes.synopsis: Syr had her chance. It’s Freya’s turn now, and the goddess will use any means necessary to make all of Orario understand that Bell is hers. Completely. Undeniably. Hers.

episodes.title: Orario: Distorted City
episodes.synopsis: Bell claims he’s part of the Hestia Familia. But that can’t be right, he’s always been part of the Freya Familia. His own Familia and goddess wouldn’t lie to him, right?

episodes.title: Loneliness: Separated
episodes.synopsis: Freya’s control was never absolute. There will always be those who slipped through the cracks and cannot accept the new status quo.

episodes.title: Bell Cranel: Desires
episodes.synopsis: Everyone has a breaking point, and Bell is approaching his limit. He has two choices left: he can either give in and accept Freya’s affections, or forge ahead as his true self.

episodes.title: Vesta: Altar of the Sacred Flame
episodes.synopsis: As Bell discovers the truth about Syr and confronts Freya, Hestia unleashes her power. She is the Goddess of the Hearth, which makes her the most formidable deity in Orario.

episodes.title: War Game: The Great Faction Battle
episodes.synopsis: Freya declares a War Game against the Hestia Famila. The terms are simple: if Freya wins, Bell will be hers. But if she loses? She will return to Heaven.

episodes.title: Folkvangr: Hell
episodes.synopsis: The Hestia Familia may have formed an alliance for the War Game, but the Freya Familia earned its fearsome reputation for a reason. The allied army is about to find out why.

episodes.title: Astrea Record: Inheritance
episodes.synopsis: Defeat is imminent. As the allied army falls, they need a miracle to win. But just as all hope fades, a gale-force wind begins to howl.

episodes.title: Revenge: Counterattack
episodes.synopsis: Unexpected reinforcements and a sudden betrayal have turned the tide of battle. The allied army now has a chance at victory, but they must fight tooth and nail to seize it.

episodes.title: Einherjar: The Warriors of the Goddess
episodes.synopsis: Only two adventurers stand between the allied army and Freya. Unfortunately, Ottarl and Allen are the Freya Familia's most formidable warriors.

episodes.title: Syr: "First Love"
episodes.synopsis: Freya loved a mortal who would never love her back, and both she and others suffered for it. The conflict she started is ending, and the goddess must face her final fate.

info.title: Dark Moon: The Blood Altar Animation with ENHYPEN
info.synopsis: Benvenuti a Riverfield, dove i ragazzi più popolari di due scuole rivali sono in realtà vampiri e licantropi. Ma quando Sooha, una misteriosa ragazza, si trasferisce nella città tutti quanti finiscono inspiegabilmente per essere attratti da lei. Mentre orribili incidenti iniziano a scuotere Riverfield, il passato dimenticato dei ragazzi inizia lentamente a svelarsi capovolgendo il loro mondo.

episodes.title: New Moon: Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Seven boys with a secret attend a night school. They are strangely drawn to the transfer student Sooha.

episodes.title: Crescent Moon: The Wolves Who Climbed over the Wall
episodes.synopsis: Sooha runs into some Sunshine City School students. They suspect Heli and the boys murdered their classmate.

episodes.title: Half Moon: The Pre-emptive Date
episodes.synopsis: Sooha loses Shion while out on a date with him and is confronted by vampires with sharp fangs.

episodes.title: Blood Moon: Night of the Total Eclipse
episodes.synopsis: Sooha dreams of Chris, who died when they were young, and heads to the seaside.

episodes.title: Waxing Moon: Bite My Neck
episodes.synopsis: The boys learn Sooha despises vampires, but Heli resolves to give a party invitation to Sooha anyway.

episodes.title: Hunter`s Moon: Birthday Party
episodes.synopsis: Sooha attends the boys' birthday party. Afterward, she returns to the mansion and witnesses a shocking sight.

episodes.title: Blue Moon: That`s Fate
episodes.synopsis: Chris attacks Sooha. In a moment of desperation, Solon's secret is revealed.

episodes.title: Old Moon: Vampire Lord
episodes.synopsis: The day of the nightball game arrives. As an intense game plays out, a shadow sneaks up on Sooha.

episodes.title: Misty Moon: The Black Mist of Railgun
episodes.synopsis: Having regained their memories from their past lives, the boys head to the Vanfield House.

episodes.title: Waning Moon: Mortal Combat in Automnal
episodes.synopsis: The boys arrive in Autonal in search of the sword, but a powerful enemy stands in their way!

episodes.title: Hazy Moon: Vargr`s Blood
episodes.synopsis: Dardan faces the lycanthrope who is the final key to his ritual, and the boys head to the altar.

episodes.title: Dark Moon: The Moon Altar
episodes.synopsis: The boys despair as Dardan attempts to seize everything, but their true power is awakened!

info.title: Detective Conan Movie 28: Il flashback a un occhio solo
info.synopsis: Chiamato dal suo ex-collega del dipartimento di polizia "Wani", Kogoro si reca insieme a Conan nella prefettura di Nagano. Una loro vecchia conoscenza, il detective Kansuke Yamato, lo aveva infatti citato nel rapporto di un caso di alcuni mesi antecedenti, caso nel quale lo stesso Kansuke era stato travolto, e miracolosamente sopravvissuto, a una valanga dopo un inseguimento. Kogoro e Conan arrivano quindi all'incontro con "Wani" quando subito si sente uno sparo...

episodes.title: Welcome
episodes.synopsis: New residents mean building new homes. There's just one problem: regular houses do not fit the needs of minotaurs and centaurs.

episodes.title: The Newcomers
episodes.synopsis: A change of plans is in order. If the current village can't support the new residents, the solution is simple: build more villages.

episodes.title: Winter
episodes.synopsis: The Great Tree Village experiences another winter.

episodes.title: Martial Arts Competition
episodes.synopsis: What better way to mark a celebration than with a martial arts competition?

episodes.title: Another Peaceful Day
episodes.synopsis: From curing an illness to cultivating new crops to even Mountain Elves curating Hiraku’s favor, life in the Great Tree Village is never dull.

episodes.title: Fine Day for Visitors
episodes.synopsis: Hiraku has his hands full as mayor. Not only is he tasked with a series of angelic trials, but he must also mediate a draconic relationship.

episodes.title: Hot Spring Expedition
episodes.synopsis: A hot springs expedition quickly gets out of hand.

episodes.title: More Hot Spring Expedition
episodes.synopsis: They've dealt with the Lord of Death. Now they need to decide what to do with the black stones.

episodes.title: Return to Ordinary
episodes.synopsis: A feast celebrates the excavation of the black stones.

episodes.title: Festivities and Fuushu`s Gratitude
episodes.synopsis: The passage of time brings change. A new competition is held, Alfred grows older, and new settlers arrive.

episodes.title: Castle in the Air
episodes.synopsis: The village must face a flying castle inhabited by demons.

episodes.title: A Village for All
episodes.synopsis: When the Sun Castle's inhabitants join the Great Tree Village, Hiraku decides it's time to unite everyone under a single banner.

info.title: Questa allegra gioventù (ITA)
info.synopsis: Kasumi (Marina nella versione italiana) è una quindicenne allegra, solare e luminosa, che, iscrittasi a una scuola superiore lontana da casa, va a vivere nel pensionato gestito dalla zia vedova. Qui la ragazza conoscerà gli sgangherati coinquilini, tutti suoi coetanei: l’affascinante ma perennemente allupato Shin; il mastodontico Takashi, dal cuore grande quanto il suo stomaco; il misterioso Makoto, controverso personaggio con l’abitudine di sbucar fuori all'improvviso; e infine Yusaku, un ragazzo spensierato e altruista privo di particolari doti sportive. Compagna di scuola dei nostri è poi Keiko, ragazza carina e dai modi gentili ambita da molti ma segretamente infatuata di Yusaku.

episodes.title: A new life
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi Kishimoto, 15 years old, is a freshman attending to Meijou High School from her aunt's house, which runs her boarding house. Her life has begun with her natural-blurred aunt and the four unique boarders.

episodes.title: Nuovi amici di scuola
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi gets entangled by cheering team members at Meijou High School. At that time, Yusaku Takasugi, a boarder, appears. Yusaku is a friend who met a naked one in the bath!?

episodes.title: La cartolina
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi and Yusaku Takasugi become classmates. Kasumi says she will join the track and field club, and Yusaku will join that cheering squad. Yusaku wants to support people who work hard!

episodes.title: Il capitano
episodes.synopsis: Yusaku is ordered by the cheerleader Sakamoto to bring Kasumi, but he gets feverish and collapses. Yusaku who saw Kasumi being taken from the health room...

episodes.title: Il ritorno di Corrado
episodes.synopsis: Is Sakamoto, the cheerleader, really bad? He had a cute hairpin labeled "Michiko". It's something strange.

episodes.title: Vecchi rancori
episodes.synopsis: Kodama, the person Sakamoto caused the violence, called Sakamoto again. Kodama seems to be the lover of Michiko Takagi, the owner of the hairpin that Sakamoto had.

episodes.title: Una squadra tutta nuova
episodes.synopsis: Sakamoto filed a dropout notice, and Yusaku, who was entrusted with the group, was enthusiastic. The favorable Keiko's older brother Seki, the ace of the baseball club, asked him to make the baseball club even more exciting.

episodes.title: La gara di salto in alto
episodes.synopsis: Yusaku invites Kasumi to the manager of the baseball club, but she didn't feel like devoting herself to athletics. However, she looks like Yusaku who supports people.

episodes.title: La partita di baseball
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi, who became the manager of the baseball club, puts thirst on the members. Such a baseball club has a chance to play a practice match with a prestigious school that is a candidate for victory.

episodes.title: Lezioni di baseball
episodes.synopsis: Yusaku decides to take the place of the injured center. He's trying hard, but it doesn't work. However, Seki knew the nature and guts of Yusaku.

episodes.title: Il concerto
episodes.synopsis: Keiko is worried about the relationship between Kasumi and Yusaku. She takes the courage to invite Yusaku to a concert. Kasumi devotes herself to her housework, but she becomes concerned about Yusaku.

episodes.title: Una lettera per Marina
episodes.synopsis: The combination of summer qualifying tournaments has also been decided, and the practice of the baseball club has also become enthusiastic. It's the last summer for captain Seki... he had a special thought.

episodes.title: La prima partita delle eliminatorie
episodes.synopsis: It's the first round of the summer Koshien qualifying tournament. Kasumi encourages the nervous members. Her lover "Katsuhiko" will return from America during the summer vacation.

episodes.title: Doveri di manager
episodes.synopsis: It's raining on the first round. The Meijou baseball club, which defeated Torijou High School, was enthusiastic about the second round. At that time, Yusaku was asked by Mikimoto about his feelings for Keiko.

episodes.title: Una partita difficile
episodes.synopsis: It's quarterfinals for the members who are proud of their time. Kasumi and Yusaku don't talk about each other, but they bother each other. Kasumi takes care of Yusaku who was injured in the game all night.

episodes.title: Anche il tifo ha la sua parte
episodes.synopsis: It's finally the semi-final. Kasumi worries about Yusaku who behaves well. Her last night with Yusaku flickers during the phone call from Katsuhiko. Yusaku's appearance is still Kasumi.

episodes.title: La sorpresa
episodes.synopsis: Finally advanced to the final! Yusaku was participating in the cheering party, but he's dying for Kasumi's lover "Katsuhiko" to return to Japan.

episodes.title: Forti emozioni
episodes.synopsis: In the middle of the final match, Katsuhiko suddenly appeared. Yusaku, who was looking at the joyful Kasumi from the mound, missed the ball he could get.

episodes.title: Il primo bacio
episodes.synopsis: They lost the final game, but they have no regrets. They have a disappointing party with the usual noodles. However, Katsuhiko also participates there. Katsuhiko is conscious of Yusaku to Kasumi who praises Yusaku.

episodes.title: Vacanze al mare
episodes.synopsis: It's summer vacation. The aunt drove to the sea and everybody enjoyed being divided into couples. Suddenly, a girl named Maria, appears in front of Yusaku.

episodes.title: Una grigliata movimentata
episodes.synopsis: The aunt invited Shinichiro, who had become close to him at the beach, to a barbecue. His daughter who appeared with him was Maria who tried to kiss Yusaku.

episodes.title: Il rivale
episodes.synopsis: Yusaku and the other boarders all went home, and Kasumi was alone with Katsuhiko. However, she is worried about Yusaku.

episodes.title: Scommettiamo
episodes.synopsis: Katsuhiko, who declared his rival to Yusaku, "I will propose to Kasumi," has to go back to America. What is Katsuhiko who talks about his passion for baseball?

episodes.title: Cara Marina
episodes.synopsis: After returning to America, Katsuhiko recalled the days he spent with Kasumi and his encounter with Yusaku. Kasumi's feelings for her lover are beginning to lean toward Yusaku.

episodes.title: Una serata in lavanderia
episodes.synopsis: On Sunday, when the summer vacation is over, Kasumi, who is awakened early in the morning due to the commotion of the housemates, is in a bad mood and collided head-on with Yusaku on the stairs! Why does she get mad?

episodes.title: L’appuntamento
episodes.synopsis: Yusaku, who was listening to the late-night broadcast, happened to hear a love call to Kasumi. Is that person the 4th ace they met at the coin laundry?

episodes.title: L’apparenza inganna
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi has decided to date the ace no. 4 Takanezawa because of Yusaku who bought the role of Cupid. The shadow of Yusaku at the meeting place!?

episodes.title: Una notte tempestosa
episodes.synopsis: After this day a typhoon is coming. Kasumi and Yusaku is now alone in the boarding house. Somehow they become conscious of each other and become awkward.

episodes.title: Tutti per il baseball
episodes.synopsis: The baseball team is told by the coach that they will not participate in the autumn tournament. Yusaku of the cheering squad protests directly to the principal! Kasumi also came there. Is Koshien a demon gate?

episodes.title: Come convincere un direttore
episodes.synopsis: Members who were told that they could not participate in the official game without the cooperation of the school. They have to do something about it! Yusaku started to move for the baseball club again.

episodes.title: Il nuovo allenatore
episodes.synopsis: Yusaku and Kasumi's enthusiasm was transmitted to the school side, the members were gathered again, and the baseball club was appointed as a new coach. A transfer student came to the two classes.

episodes.title: Un insolito allenamento
episodes.synopsis: The new coach of the baseball club was Kasumi's lover Katsuhiko. He said he came back from America because he wanted to play baseball, but he also wanted to marry Kasumi.

episodes.title: Ricomincia il campionato
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi was upset when Katsuhiko returned to Japan and couldn't concentrate on the practice of the track and field club. Meanwhile, the first round of the baseball club's autumn tournament, the debut match of new coach Katsuhiko has begun.

episodes.title: Un allenatore all’avanguardia
episodes.synopsis: Katsuhiko, the new coach returning from America, said he would go to the pool. Members who swim without touching the pole. Why are they swimming when they are in the baseball club?

episodes.title: Romeo e Giulietta
episodes.synopsis: The theater festival season has arrived. The theme is "Romeo and Juliet". The protagonists are Yusaku and Kasumi. However, Yusaku suddenly drops off and starts a part-time job.

episodes.title: La festa di Natale
episodes.synopsis: Everybody decided to have a Christmas party at Maria's house. Kasumi goes shopping with Yusaku, but Yusaku who broke up on the way does not come back easily.

episodes.title: Il quiz in tv
episodes.synopsis: December. Kasumi and the boarders who are supposed to go home have changed their schedule!? Her aunt applied for the high school couple tournament of the quiz show without permission and won the prize.

episodes.title: La prova di resistenza
episodes.synopsis: Club competition "cold patience tournament". The representative of the cheering squad is Yusaku, and the baseball club is Ariyama. Every year, they decide to participate in a harsh competition that some people faint.

episodes.title: La proposta
episodes.synopsis: After the cold weather tournament, everyone in the boarding house except Kasumi caught a cold. When Kasumi visited Katsuhiko, Maria was there.

episodes.title: La sfida di kendo
episodes.synopsis: Yusaku, who is a good friend, was asked by the kendo club, which is said to be the weakest in the prefecture, and decided to participate in the game. It is a promising Yusaku, but there was a formidable newcomer at the partner school.

episodes.title: Andiamo a sciare?
episodes.synopsis: Everybody decided to go to a ski lodge run by Mikimoto's uncle. It is said that Ariyama will not go while everyone is excited about skiing.

episodes.title: Avventura in montagna
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi together with all the others came to the ski resort. Keiko cares about Ariyama who refrains. Yusaku goes looking for Kasumi who has left alone.

episodes.title: Una vecchia foto
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi tells Yusaku that she likes it. She can't tell Katsuhiko, who has been able to talk about anything at the ski resort, and her heart begins to get confused.

episodes.title: Una partita di allenamento
episodes.synopsis: "Don't run away from your feelings," says Yusaku from Katsuhiko. On the other hand, Kasumi heard that Katsuhiko refused an unexpected practice match.

episodes.title: La sfida
episodes.synopsis: Members who burn in the red and white game in the team. It was a match where they can feel the results of the practice, and the quality of Yusaku was also evaluated. Katsuhiko joined as a pitcher there.

episodes.title: Una decisione difficile
episodes.synopsis: It's a serious match between Katsuhiko and Yusaku. Katsuhiko asks "Is it regrettable?" to Yusaku who lost in a splendid strikeout. Isn't Yusaku really wanting to play baseball?

episodes.title: La lettera
episodes.synopsis: An express delivery from her mother arrived at Kasumi. The content was that she might transfer to another school due to the circumstances of her parents' home. She is worried about her friends and Yusaku.

episodes.title: Festa d’addio
episodes.synopsis: Kasumi decided to transfer to another school. Four of her boarding house friends who lived under the same roof held a bright farewell party. Yusaku, everyone, thank you!

info.title: Dara-san of Reiwa
info.synopsis: In un giorno di tempesta, due fratelli curiosi attraversano una zona da sempre vietata e incontrano una creatura mostruosa e bizzarra, considerata un essere leggendario e temuto. Nonostante il suo aspetto inquietante, i bambini non si spaventano e la chiamano semplicemente "Dara-san", dando così inizio a un'insolita convivenza fatta di incontri soprannaturali, situazioni comiche e avventure surreali che mescolano horror e umorismo nell’era moderna.

episodes.title: Yamatagi-Madara of the Accursed Land
episodes.synopsis: On a secluded mountain, a mysterious entity exists that the locals are warned to go nowhere near...

episodes.title: Visiting the School for the First Time
episodes.synopsis: Dara-san, curious about Kaoru and Hinata's lives, decides to stealthily slither around to see what's going on.

episodes.title: The Laws of Forbidden Ground
episodes.synopsis: Dara-san's wardrobe expands as she teaches Kaoru and Hinata about treading into supernatural territory.

episodes.title: The Return of Yamatagi-Madara
episodes.synopsis: An unexpected new student arrives in Hinata's class.

episodes.title: Genealogy of Mountain Stewards
episodes.synopsis: Hinata has a birthday, and her mom, Chiyo, reminiscences about her encounters with the mountain's guardian.

episodes.title: The Phantom Water God
episodes.synopsis: Hinata and Kaoru head out of town where they have an encounter with a different supernatural entity.

episodes.title: A Picture Show of Bygone Days
episodes.synopsis: Dara-san wonders about the circumstances on the mountain after she lost her mind as a cursed spirit.

episodes.title: A Serpent`s Struggles
episodes.synopsis: Yamatagi-Madara plots his revenge on Dara-san with questionable results.

episodes.title: Seven Wonders of the School
episodes.synopsis: Hinata is staying late at her middle school to prep for the culture festival.

episodes.title: A Culture Festival for Two
episodes.synopsis: While Hinata works her school's culture festival, Kaoru sets up a private cafe for Dara-san.

episodes.title: The Taboo Test of Courage
episodes.synopsis: Hinata's classmates venture up the mountain.

episodes.title: How to Spend New Years
episodes.synopsis: At the end of the winter holiday, Dara-san and the siblings arrange for a movie viewing party.

episodes.title: Dara-san of the Reiwa Era
episodes.synopsis: A movie screening in Dara-san's territory leads to an unexpected confrontation with an old threat...

info.title: Yatterman Remake (ITA)
info.synopsis: Remake o, meglio, riadattamento della serie classica degli anni '70. La serie racconta le stravaganti avventure di Gan-chan, giovane geniale e un po’ distratto, e Ai-chan, più seria e affidabile. I due protagonisti combattono contro il trio Doronbo, comandato dal perfido Dokurobei, che è alla ricerca dei cinque anelli “Dokuro” (nella serie originale erano alla ricerca di una sola pietra) che, una volta uniti, potranno realizzare qualsiasi desiderio.
